notes.title: 1 Step towards Streets
notes.content:
- Adjusted rolling resistances to fit for Streets better
- Added, A taste of Streets into proto map

notes.title: Vert Update
notes.content: -Work done to vert landing sensors to allow for more consistent SPINE transfers and better hold into transition overall. It's a tad bit more aggressive to get closer to the Streets way but we can successfully ride the main test map bowl for long periods without getting thrown to the lower flats.

notes.title: Performance
notes.content: - Fixed major memory leak

notes.title: Human
notes.content: - Updates to Mash Man

notes.title: Human
notes.content: - Added Mash Man character to bmx, scooter and Long Boy Bike. Do a trick to fix the first animation

notes.title: Audio and Physics
notes.content:
- Overhauled center of mass and pivots in preparation to replace cube with human.
- Added "wooshing" SFX to headset joint
- Added "wooshing" SFX to wheel hub joints
- Added "Chirp" SFX to wheels
- Added RPM out signal from Wheels so FX and visuals rotate properly
- Trick animations are fully rotating about there intended axis now. They were not all there before. Example : try a Table now with Proto-Uni and you will see...

notes.title: Vert Update
notes.content:
- Adjustments to vert magnets.
- Added, Anti-Case sensors. A small auto tuck up happens sometimes. Dropping into bowls should be more successful

notes.title: Drive Train and More
notes.content:
- All BMX parts are showing now. so Frame, Bar, Stem ect
- Drive train is physically animated
- Added, 2 more degrees of freedom between the vehicle and the rider. Lateral forward/back, and Lateral left/right. Landing sideways will display this as you see the rider absorb "sloppy landings"

notes.title: Physics and Tricks
notes.content:
- Adjustments to overall inertia relationships between the Vehicle and the Cube Body making tricks like flip whips possible
- Minor adjustments to spin/flip accelerations and "weightyness". Spinning one direction and changing spin directions should feel "heavier". AKA spin input moto whips feel noice!
- Minor adjustment to manny input hold point
- Camera work is done so the camera does not clip into steep surfaces as much
- Cranks and Pedals added to the physics rig
- Manny input hold point tightened
- Manny angle control has a lower low angle and higher high angle

notes.title: Trick Update
notes.content:
-Improvements to physics-based tricks. (They don't flip you over up-side-down any more)
-Tricks are now triggered the same as BMX Streets
-Manny input is the same as BMX Streets 
-Nosey input is the same as BMX Streets
-Tuck removed from trigger since we have normal double trigger Tuck-Ups now

notes.title: Manny/Nosey Update
notes.content:
- Manny/Nosey input now act the same as BMX Streets. A hold point is required
- Added Barspins with Bumpers

notes.title: Wheel Update
notes.content:
-Minor changes to flip stabilizers, Nosey/Manny stabilizers
-Tire Skid Marks

notes.title: Whip Update
notes.content:
- Changes to the whip so it takes a more realistic orbit
- Smoothing to Air/Vert surface mapping

notes.title: Physics-Based Whips
notes.content: - Changed the Barspin to a Whip for now

notes.title: Flip Adjustment #2
notes.content:
- Slight change to spin/flip acceleration
- Wall rides are working again. (was a bit funky last build)
- Added NPC to ProtoSports
- Yaw spin axis shifted forward

notes.content: - Drone is deployable in ProtoSports using the X Button for now. This is a good tool to set session markers quicky similar to that of a "Pin Dropper".
